report.summary: daedalus/context_plan.py: Hybrid, evidence-bearing context planning over the Daedalus Knowledge Forest, combining lexical BM25 and latent event-path seeds into a DSS-guided plan.
risks: CLAIMS|daedalus/context_plan.py|The planner turns a natural-language objective into file-level seed evidence, then delegates coarse-to-fine propagation to DSS.
CLAIMS|daedalus/context_plan.py|plan_context: 'No source material is emitted or rewritten.'
